words.en: The slope averages about 1 in 30, but contains steep, probably vertical, cliffs, and gentle sediment-covered terraces, and near its lower reaches there is a long tailing-off which is almost certainly the result of material transported out to deep water after being eroded from the continental masses.
words.zh: 坡度平均约为三十分之一，但包含陡峭的、可能是垂直的悬崖和平缓的沉积物覆盖的阶地，在其下游附近有一个长长的斜坡，几乎可以肯定，这是物质被大陆块侵蚀后输送到深水的结果。

words.en: Appreciation of sculpture depends upon the ability to respond to form in 3 dimensions.
words.zh: 对雕塑的欣赏取决于对三维形式做出反应的能力。

words.en: That is perhaps why sculpture has been described as the most difficult of all arts; certainly it is more difficult than the arts which involve appreciation of flat forms, shape in only two dimensions.
words.zh: 这也许就是为什么雕塑被称为所有艺术中最难的一门。当然，它比涉及平面形式、仅二维形状的艺术的欣赏更困难。

words.en: Many more people are 'form-blind' than colour-blind.
words.zh: “色盲”的人比“色盲”的人多得多。

words.en: The child learning to see, first distinguishes only two-dimensional shape; it cannot judge distances, depths.
words.zh: 孩子在学习看东西时，首先只能区分二维形状；它无法判断距离、深度。

words.en: Later, for its personal safety and practical needs, it has to develop (partly by means of touch) the ability to judge roughly 3-dimensonal distances.
words.zh: 后来，出于人身安全和实际需要，它必须发展（部分通过触摸）判断大致3维距离的能力。

words.en: But having satisfied the requirements of practical necessity, most people go no further.
words.zh: 但在满足了现实需要后，大多数人就不再继续了。

words.en: Though they may attain considerable accuracy in the perception of flat form, they do not make the further intellectual and emotional effort needed to comprehend form in its full spatial existence.
words.zh: 尽管他们在感知平面形式方面可能获得相当高的准确性，但他们并没有做出进一步的智力和情感努力来理解形式的完整空间存在。

words.en: This is what the sculptor must do.
words.zh: 这是雕塑家必须做的。

words.en: He must strive continually to think of and use, form in its full spatial completeness.
words.zh: 他必须不断努力思考和使用形式的完整空间完整性。

words.en: He gets the solid shape as it were, inside his head — he thinks of it, whatever its size, as if he were holding it completely enclosed in the hollow of his hand.
words.zh: 他在他的脑袋里得到了原来的实体形状——他想到它，无论它有多大，就好像他把它完全封闭在他的手掌中一样。

words.en: He mentally visualizes a complex form from all round itself; he knows while he looks at one side what the other side is like; he identifies himself with its centre of gravity, its mass, its weight; he realizes its volume as the space that the shape displaces in the air.
words.zh: 他在脑海中想象出一个来自四周的复杂形状；当他看一侧时，他知道另一侧是什么样子；他用它的重心、质量、重量来识别自己；他意识到它的体积是形状在空气中所取代的空间。

words.en: And the sensitive observer of sculpture must also learn to feel shape simply as shape, not as description or reminiscence.
words.zh: 敏感的雕塑观察者也必须学会将形状仅仅作为形状来感受，而不是作为描述或回忆。

words.en: He must, for example, perceive an egg as a simple single solid shape quite apart from its significance as food, or from the literary idea that it will become a bird.
words.zh: 例如，他必须将鸡蛋视为一个简单的单一固体形状，这与它作为食物的意义无关，或者与它会变成一只鸟的文学观念无关。

words.en: And so with solids such as a shell, a nut, a plum, a pear, a tadpole, a mushroom, a mountain peak, a kidney, a carrot, a tree-trunk, a bird, a bud, a lark, a ladybird, a bulrush, a bone.
words.zh: 贝壳、坚果、李子、梨、蝌蚪、蘑菇、山峰、肾、胡萝卜、树干、鸟、花蕾、云雀、瓢虫、芦苇、骨头等固体也是如此。

words.en: From these he can go on to appreciate more complex forms or combinations of several forms.
words.zh: 由此，他可以继续欣赏更复杂的形式或几种形式的组合。

words.en: In his own lifetime Galileo was the centre of violent controversy, but the scientific dust has long since settled, and today we can see even his famous clash with the Inquisition in something like its proper perspective.
words.zh: 伽利略在世时曾是激烈争议的中心，但科学尘埃早已尘埃落定，今天我们甚至可以从正确的角度看待他与宗教裁判所的著名冲突。

words.en: But, in contrast, it is only in modern times that Galileo has become a problem child for historians of science.
words.zh: 但相比之下，直到现代伽利略才成为科学史学家的问题儿童。

words.en: The old view of Galileo was delightfully uncomplicated.
words.zh: 伽利略的旧观点非常简单。

words.en: He was, above all, a man who experimented: who despised the prejudice and book learning of the Aristotelians, who put his questions to nature instead of to the ancients, and who drew his conclusions fearlessly.
words.zh: 首先，他是一个勇于实验的人：他鄙视亚里士多德学派的偏见和书本知识，他向自然而不是古人提出问题，并且无所畏惧地得出结论。

words.en: He had been the first to turn a telescope to the sky, and he had seen there evidence enough to overthrow Aristotle and Ptolemy together.
words.zh: 他是第一个将望远镜转向天空的人，他在那里看到的证据足以推翻亚里士多德和托勒密。

words.en: He was the man who climbed the Leaning Tower of Pisa and dropped various weights from the top, who rolled balls down inclined planes, and then generalized the results of his many experiments into the famous law of free fall.
words.zh: 他登上了比萨斜塔，从塔顶扔下各种重物，将球滚下斜面，然后将他的许多实验结果推广到著名的自由落体定律。

words.en: But a closer study of the evidence, supported by a deeper sense of the period, and particularly by a new consciousness of the philosophical undercurrents in the scientific revolution, has profoundly modified this view of Galileo.
words.zh: 但对证据的更仔细研究，加上对那个时代的更深刻的认识，特别是对科学革命中哲学暗流的新认识的支持，深刻地改变了伽利略的这一观点。

words.en: Today, although the old Galileo lives on in many popular writings, among historians of science a new and more sophisticated picture has emerged.
words.zh: 如今，尽管古老的伽利略在许多流行著作中仍然存在，但科学史学家们却出现了一幅新的、更复杂的图景。

words.en: At the same time our sympathy for Galileo's opponents has grown somewhat.
words.zh: 与此同时，我们对伽利略的反对者的同情有所增加。

words.en: His telescopic observations are justly immortal; they aroused great interest at the time, they had important theoretical consequences, and they provided a striking demonstration of the potentialities hidden in instruments and apparatus.
words.zh: 他的望远镜观察结果确实是不朽的。它们在当时引起了极大的兴趣，产生了重要的理论后果，并且令人震惊地展示了仪器和设备中隐藏的潜力。

words.en: But can we blame those who looked and failed to see what Galileo saw, if we remember that to use a telescope at the limit of its powers calls for long experience and intimate familiarity with one's instrument?
words.zh: 但是，如果我们记得使用望远镜的极限能力需要长期的经验和对仪器的熟悉，我们是否可以责怪那些看过但未能看到伽利略所看到的东西的人呢？

words.en: Was the philosopher who refused to look through Galileo's telescope more culpable than those who alleged that the spiral nebulae observed with Lord Rosse's great telescope in the 1840s were scratches left by the grinder?
words.zh: 那些拒绝通过伽利略望远镜观察的哲学家是否比那些声称 1840 年代用罗斯勋爵的大望远镜观察到的螺旋星云是研磨机留下的划痕的哲学家更有罪？

words.en: We can perhaps forgive those who said the moons of Jupiter were produced by Galileo's spyglass if we recall that in his day, as for centuries before, curved glass was the popular contrivance for producing not truth but illusion, untruth; and if a single curved glass would distort nature, how much more would a pair of them?
words.zh: 如果我们回想一下，在他的时代，就像几个世纪之前一样，曲面玻璃是流行的发明，它不是产生真理，而是产生幻觉和谎言，那么我们也许可以原谅那些说木星的卫星是由伽利略的望远镜产生的人。如果单块曲面玻璃都会扭曲自然，那么一对曲面玻璃更会扭曲自然吗？

words.en: Education is one of the key words of our time.
words.zh: 教育是我们这个时代的关键词之一。

words.en: A man without an education, many of us believe, is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances, deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities.
words.zh: 我们许多人认为，一个没有受过教育的人是不利环境的不幸受害者，被剥夺了二十世纪最伟大的机会之一。

words.en: Convinced of the importance of education, modern states 'invest' in institutions of learning to get back 'interest' in the form of a large group of enlightened young men and women who are potential leaders.
words.zh: 现代国家深信教育的重要性，对学习机构进行“投资”，以培养大批开明的年轻男女，他们是潜在的领导者，以重新获得“兴趣”。

words.en: Education, with its cycles of instruction so carefully worked out, punctuated by textbooks — those purchasable wells of wisdom — what would civilization be like without its benefits?
words.zh: 教育，其教学周期如此精心设计，并以教科书为间断——那些可以购买的智慧之井——如果没有它的好处，文明会是什么样子？

words.en: So much is certain: that we would have doctors and preachers, lawyers and defendants marriages and births — but our spiritual outlook would be different.
words.zh: 有很多事情是确定的：我们会有医生和传教士、律师和被告、婚姻和生育——但我们的精神面貌会有所不同。

words.en: We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory, on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens.
words.zh: 我们会更少地强调“事实和数据”，而更多地强调良好的记忆力、应用心理学以及一个人与同胞相处的能力。

words.en: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.
words.zh: 如果我们的教育体系是按照过去无书本的方式建立的，我们就会拥有可以想象到的最民主的“大学”形式。

words.en: Among tribal people all knowledge inherited by tradition is shared by all; it is taught to every member of the tribe so that in this respect everybody is equally equipped for life.
words.zh: 在部落人民中，所有传统继承的知识都是所有人共享的；它被传授给部落的每个成员，以便在这方面每个人都平等地为生活做好准备。

words.en: It is the ideal condition of the 'equal start' which only our most progressive forms of modern education try to regain.
words.zh: 这是“平等起点”的理想条件，只有我们最进步的现代教育形式才试图重新获得这种条件。

words.en: In primitive cultures the obligation to seek and to receive the traditional instruction is binding to all.
words.zh: 在原始文化中，寻求和接受传统指导的义务对所有人都有约束力。

words.en: There are no'illiterates' — if the term can be applied to peoples without a script — while our own compulsory school attendance became law in Germany in 1642, in France in 1806, and in England in 1876 and is still nonexistent in a number of 'civilized' nations.
words.zh: 不存在“文盲”——如果这个词可以适用于没有文字的民族的话——而我们自己的义务教育在德国于1642年、在法国于1806年、在英国于1876年成为法律，并且在许多“文明”国家中仍然不存在。
words.ipa: /ðˈeə/ /ɑː/ /nˈɒɪlˌɪtəɹˌeɪts/ /ɪf/ /ðə/ /tˈɜːm/ /kˈæn/ /bˈiː/ /ɐplˈaɪd/ /tə/ /pˈiːpəlz/ /wɪðˈaʊt/ /ə/ /skɹˈɪpt/ /wˈaɪl/ /ˌaʊɐ/ /ˈəʊn/ /kəmpˈʌlsəɹɪ/ /skˈuːl/ /ɐtˈɛndəns/ /bɪkˈeɪm/ /lˈɔː/ /ˈɪn/ /dʒˈɜːmənɪ/ /ˈɪn/ /wˈɒn θˈaʊzənd sˈɪkshˈʌndɹɪdən fˈɔːtɪ tˈuː/ /ˈɪn/ /fɹˈɑːns/ /ˈɪn/ /wˈɒn θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪthˈʌndɹɪdən sˈɪks/ /ənd/ /ˈɪn/ /ˈɪŋɡlənd/ /ˈɪn/ /wˈɒn θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪthˈʌndɹɪdən sˈɛvəntɪ sˈɪks/ /ənd/ /ɪz/ /stˈɪl/ /nˌɒnɪɡzˈɪstənt/ /ˈɪn/ /ə/ /nˈʌmbɐ/ /əv/ /sˈɪvəlˌaɪzd/ /nˈeɪʃənz/

words.en: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries.
words.zh: 这表明我们花了多长时间才认为有必要确保我们所有的孩子都能分享过去几个世纪中“幸福的少数”积累的知识。

words.en: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means.
words.zh: 荒野教育不是金钱问题。

words.en: All are entitled to an equal start.
words.zh: 所有人都有权享有平等的起点。

words.en: There is none of the hurry which, in our society, often hampers the full development of a growing personality.
words.zh: 在我们的社会中，没有任何匆忙常常会阻碍成长中的个性的充分发展。

words.en: There, a child grows up under the everpresent attention of his parents; therefore the jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency'.
words.zh: 在那里，孩子在父母无时无刻的关注下成长；因此，丛林和大草原上不存在“青少年犯罪”。

words.en: No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children, and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.
words.zh: 离家谋生的必要性不会导致对孩子的忽视，也没有哪个父亲会面临无法为孩子“购买”教育的情况。

words.en: Parents are often upset when their children praise the homes of their friends and regard it as a slur on their own cooking, or cleaning, or furniture, and often are foolish enough to let the adolescents see that they are annoyed.
words.zh: 当孩子称赞朋友的家并认为这是对自己做饭、清洁或家具的侮辱时，父母常常会感到不安，而且常常愚蠢地让青少年看到他们很生气。

words.en: They may even accuse them of disloyalty, or make some spiteful remark about the friends' parents.
words.zh: 他们甚至可能指责他们不忠诚，或者对朋友的父母进行一些恶毒的评论。

words.en: Such a loss of dignity and descent into childish behaviour on the part of the adults deeply shocks the adolescents, and makes them resolve that in future they will not talk to their parents about the places or people they visit.
words.zh: 成年人这种丧失尊严、陷入幼稚行为的行为让青少年深感震惊，并让他们下定决心，今后不再与父母谈论他们去过的地方或去过的人。

words.en: Before very long the parents will be complaining that the child is so secretive and never tells them anything, but they seldom realize that they have brought this on themselves.
words.zh: 不久之后，父母就会抱怨孩子太守口如瓶，从来不告诉他们任何事情，但他们很少意识到这是他们自己造成的。

words.en: Disillusionment with the parents, however good and adequate they may be both as parents and as individuals, is to some degree inevitable.
words.zh: 对父母的幻想破灭，无论他们作为父母和个人多么优秀和足够，在某种程度上都是不可避免的。

words.en: Most children have such a high ideal of their parents, unless the parents themselves have been unsatisfactory, that it can hardly hope to stand up to a realistic evaluation.
words.zh: 大多数孩子对父母的理想是如此之高，除非父母本身一直不如人意，否则很难指望经得起现实的评价。

words.en: Parents would be greatly surprised and deeply touched if they realized how much belief their children usually have in their character and infallibility, and how much this faith means to a child.
words.zh: 如果父母意识到他们的孩子通常对自己的品格和正确无误有多大的信念，以及这种信念对孩子的意义有多大，他们会感到非常惊讶和深深的感动。

words.en: If parents were prepared for this adolescent reaction, and realized that was a sign that the child was growing up and developing valuable powers of observation and independent judgment, they would not be so hurt, and therefore would not drive the child into opposition by resenting and resisting it.
words.zh: 如果父母对青少年的这种反应有所准备，并认识到这是孩子成长的标志，并正在发展宝贵的观察力和独立判断力，他们就不会受到如此伤害，因此也不会通过怨恨和抵制来驱使孩子反对。

words.en: The adolescent, with his passion for sincerity, always respects a parent who admits that he is wrong, or ignorant, or even that he has been unfair or unjust.
words.zh: 青少年热衷于真诚，总是尊重承认自己错误、无知、甚至不公平或不公正的父母。

words.en: What the child cannot forgive is the parents' refusal to admit these charges if the child knows them to be true.
words.zh: 孩子无法原谅的是，如果孩子知道这些指控是真实的，父母却拒绝承认这些指控。

words.en: Victorian parents believed that they kept their dignity by retreating behind an unreasoning authoritarian attitude in fact they did nothing of the kind, but children were then too cowed to let them know how they really felt.
words.zh: 维多利亚时代的父母认为，他们通过退却不合理的专制态度来维护自己的尊严，事实上他们并没有这样做，但孩子们太害怕了，不敢让他们知道自己的真实感受。

words.en: Today we tend to go to the other extreme, but on the whole this is a healthier attitude both for the child and the parent.
words.zh: 今天，我们倾向于走向另一个极端，但总的来说，这对孩子和父母来说都是一种更健康的态度。

words.en: It is always wiser and safer to face up to reality, however painful it may be at the moment.
words.zh: 无论此刻多么痛苦，面对现实总是更明智、更安全的做法。

words.en: The Moon is likely to become the industrial hub of the Solar System supplying the rocket fuels for its ships, easily obtainable from the lunar rocks in the form of liquid oxygen.
words.zh: 月球很可能成为太阳系的工业中心，为其飞船提供火箭燃料，这些燃料很容易从月球岩石中以液氧的形式获得。

words.en: The reason lies in its gravity.
words.zh: 原因就在于它的重力。

words.en: Because the Moon has only an eightieth of the Earth's mass, it requires 97% less energy to travel the quarter of a million miles from the Moon to Earth-orbit than the 200 mile-journey from Earth's surface into orbit!
words.zh: 由于月球的质量仅为地球的 80 分之一，因此从月球到地球轨道行驶 25 万英里所需的能量比从地球表面进入轨道 200 英里所需的能量少 97%！

words.en: This may sound fantastic, but it is easily calculated.
words.zh: 这听起来可能很不可思议，但很容易计算。

words.en: To escape from the Earth in a rocket, one must travel at seven miles per second.
words.zh: 要乘坐火箭逃离地球，必须以每秒七英里的速度行驶。

words.en: The comparable speed from the Moon is only 1.5 miles per second.
words.zh: 从月球出发的可比速度仅为每秒 1.5 英里。

words.en: Because the gravity on the Moon's surface is only a sixth of Earth's (remember how easily the Apollo astronauts bounded along), it takes much less energy to accelerate to that 1.5mps than it does on Earth.
words.zh: 由于月球表面的重力仅为地球的六分之一（请记住阿波罗宇航员是多么容易地跳跃），因此加速到 1.5mps 所需的能量比在地球上少得多。

words.en: Moon dwellers will be able to fly in space at only three percent of the cost of similar journeys by their terrestrial cousins.
words.zh: 月球居民将能够在太空中飞行，而成本仅为其陆地表亲类似旅程的百分之三。

words.en: Arthur C.Clark once suggested a revolutionary idea passes through three phases: 1. 'It's impossible — don't waste my time.'
words.zh: 阿瑟·C·克拉克 (Arthur C.Clark) 曾经提出，一个革命性的想法要经历三个阶段： 1. “这是不可能的——别浪费我的时间。”

words.en: 2. 'It's possible, but not worth doing.'
words.zh: 2.“这是可能的，但不值得这样做。”

words.en: 3. 'I said it was a good idea all along.'
words.zh: 3.“我一直说这是个好主意。”

words.en: The idea of colonising Mars — a world 160 times more distant than the Moon — will move decisively from the second phase to the third, when a significant number of people are living permanently in space.
words.zh: 殖民火星——一个比月球远160倍的世界——的想法将从第二阶段决定性地转向第三阶段，届时将有相当多的人永久生活在太空中。

words.en: Mars has an extraordinary fascination for would-be voyagers.
words.zh: 火星对未来的航行者有着非凡的吸引力。

words.en: America, Russia and Europe are filled with enthusiasts — many of them serious and senior scientists who dream of sending people to it.
words.zh: 美国、俄罗斯和欧洲充满了狂热者——其中许多是严肃而资深的科学家，梦想着将人们送往那里。

words.en: Their aim is understandable.
words.zh: 他们的目的是可以理解的。

words.en: It is the one world in the Solar System that is most like the Earth.
words.zh: 它是太阳系中最像地球的一个世界。

words.en: It is a world of red sandy deserts (hence its name — the Red Planet), cloudless skies, savage sandstorms, chasms wider than the Grand Canyon and at least one mountain more than twice as tall as Everest.
words.zh: 这是一个充满红色沙漠（因此得名“红色星球”）、万里无云的天空、狂暴的沙尘暴、比大峡谷还宽的峡谷和至少一座比珠穆朗玛峰高两倍以上的山峰的世界。

words.en: It seems ideal for settlement.
words.zh: 这似乎是解决问题的理想选择。

words.en: If a nation is essentialy disunited, it is left to the government to hold it together.
words.zh: 如果一个国家本质上不团结，就需要政府来维持它。

words.en: This increases the expense of government, and reduces correspondingly the amount of economic resources that could be used for developing the country.
words.zh: 这增加了政府的开支，相应地减少了可用于国家发展的经济资源。

words.en: And it should not be forgotten how small those resources are in a poor and backward country.
words.zh: 我们不应该忘记，在一个贫穷落后的国家，这些资源是多么的少。

words.en: Where the cost of government is high, resources for development are correspondingly low.
words.zh: 政府成本高的地方，发展资源相应就低。

words.en: This may be illustrated by comparing the position of a nation with that of a private business enterprise.
words.zh: 这可以通过将一个国家的地位与一个私营企业的地位进行比较来说明。

words.en: An enterprise has to incur certain costs and expenses in order to stay in business.
words.zh: 企业为了维持经营，必须承担一定的成本和费用。

words.en: For our purposes, we are concerned only with one kind of cost — the cost of managing and administering the business.
words.zh: 就我们的目的而言，我们只关心一种成本——管理和管理业务的成本。

words.en: Such administrative overheads in a business are analogous to the cost of government in a nation.
words.zh: 企业的此类行政管理费用类似于一个国家的政府成本。

words.en: The administrative overheads of a business are low to the extent that everyone working in the business can be trusted to behave in a way that best promotes the interests of the firm.
words.zh: 企业的管理费用很低，以至于可以相信在企业中工作的每个人都会以最有利于公司利益的方式行事。

words.en: If they can each be trusted to take such responsibilities, and to exercise such initiative as falls within their sphere, then administrative overheads will be low.
words.zh: 如果可以相信他们每个人都能承担这样的责任，并在自己的职责范围内发挥主动性，那么行政管理费用就会很低。

words.en: It will be low because it will be necessary to have only one man looking after each job without having another man to check upon what he is doing, keep him in line, and report on him to someone else.
words.zh: 它会很低，因为每项工作只需要一个人负责，而无需另一个人检查他正在做的事情，让他保持一致并向其他人报告他的情况。

words.en: But if no one can be trusted to act in a loyal and responsible manner towards his job, then the business will require armies of administrators, checkers and foremen and administrative overheads will rise correspondingly.
words.zh: 但如果没有人可以被信任以忠诚和负责任的方式对待他的工作，那么企业将需要大量的管理人员、检查员和领班，管理费用也会相应增加。

words.en: As administrative overheads rise, so the earnings of the business after meeting the expense of administration, will fall; and the business will have less money to distribute as dividends or invest directly in its future progress and development.
words.zh: 随着管理费用的增加，企业在支付管理费用后的收入将会下降；而且企业用于分配股息或直接投资于未来进步和发展的资金将会减少。

words.en: It is precisely the same with a nation.
words.zh: 对于一个民族来说也是如此。

words.en: To the extent that the people can be relied on to behave in a loyal and responsible manner, the government does not require armies of police and civil servants to keep them in order.
words.zh: 如果可以信赖人民以忠诚和负责任的方式行事，政府就不需要警察和公务员军队来维持秩序。

words.en: But if a nation is disunited, the government cannot be sure that the actions of the people will be in the interests of the nation; and it will have to watch, check, and control the people accordingly.
words.zh: 但如果一个国家不团结，政府就不能确定人民的行为是否符合国家的利益；它必须相应地监视、检查和控制人们。

words.en: A disunited nation therefore has to incur unduly high costs of government.
words.zh: 因此，一个分裂的国家必须承担过高的政府成本。

words.en: At the age of twelve years, the human body is at its most vigorous.
words.zh: 十二岁是人体最旺盛的时期。

words.en: It has yet to reach its full size and strength, and its owner his or her full intelligence: but at this age the likelihood of death is least.
words.zh: 它尚未达到其完整的尺寸和强度，其主人也尚未达到其完整的智力：但在这个年龄，死亡的可能性是最小的。

words.en: Earlier, we were infants and young children, and consequently more vulnerable; later, we shall undergo a progressive loss of our vigour and resistance which, though imperceptible at first will finally become so steep that we can live no longer, however well we look after ourselves, and however well society, and our doctors, look after us.
words.zh: 早些时候，我们还是婴儿和幼儿，因此更加脆弱；后来，我们的活力和抵抗力将逐渐丧失，尽管一开始难以察觉，但最终将变得如此严重，以至于我们无法再活下去，无论我们如何照顾自己，无论社会和医生如何照顾我们。

words.en: This decline in vigour with the passing of time is called ageing.
words.zh: 这种活力随着时间的流逝而下降的现象称为衰老。

words.en: It is one of the most unpleasant discoveries which we all make that we must decline in this way, that if we escape wars, accidents and diseases we shall eventually 'die of old age', and that this happens at a rate which differs little from person to person, so that there are heavy odds in favour of our dying between the ages of 65 and 80.
words.zh: 我们所有人都发现，我们必须以这种方式衰落，这是我们所有人最不愉快的发现之一，如果我们逃避战争、事故和疾病，我们最终将“死于老年”，而且这种情况发生的速度因人而异，因此，我们在65岁到80岁之间死亡的可能性很大。

words.en: Some of us will die sooner, a few will live longer — on into a ninth or tenth decade.
words.zh: 我们中的一些人会死得更快，一些人会活得更久——活到第九个或第十个十年。

words.en: But the chances are against it, and there is a virtual limit on how long we can hope to remain alive, however lucky and robust we are.
words.zh: 但机会渺茫，无论我们多么幸运和坚强，我们能活多久实际上是有限的。

words.en: Normal people tend to forget this process unless and until they are reminded of it.
words.zh: 普通人往往会忘记这个过程，除非他们被提醒。

words.en: We are so familiar with the fact that man ages, that people have for years assumed that the process of losing vigour with time, of becoming more likely to die the older we get, was something self-evident like the cooling of a hot kettle or the wearing-out of a pair of shoes.
words.zh: 我们对人会衰老的事实非常熟悉，多年来人们一直认为，随着时间的推移，活力逐渐丧失，年龄越大，死亡的可能性就越大，这一过程是不言而喻的，就像热水壶的冷却或一双鞋子的磨损一样。

words.en: They have also assumed that all animals, and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself, must in the nature of things 'wear out'.
words.zh: 他们还假设所有动物，可能还有树木等其他有机体，甚至宇宙本身，本质上都必定会“磨损”。

words.en: Most animals we commonly observe do in fact age as we do, if given the chance to live long enough; and mechanical systems like a wound watch, or the sun, do in fact run out of energy in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics (whether the whole universe does so is a moot point at present).
words.zh: 事实上，如果有机会活得足够长，我们常见的大多数动物都会像我们一样衰老。根据热力学第二定律，像上链手表或太阳这样的机械系统实际上确实会耗尽能量（目前整个宇宙是否会这样做还是一个有争议的问题）。

words.en: But these are not analogous to what happens when man ages.
words.zh: 但这些与人类衰老时发生的情况不同。

words.en: A run-down watch is still a watch and can be rewound.
words.zh: 破旧的手表仍然是手表，可以重新上发条。

words.en: An old watch, by contrast, becomes so worn and unreliable that it eventually is not worth mending.
words.zh: 相比之下，旧手表会变得非常磨损且不可靠，最终不值得修理。

words.en: But a watch could never repair itself — it does not consist of living parts, only of metal, which wears away by friction.
words.zh: 但手表永远无法自我修复——它不包含活动部件，仅由金属组成，会因摩擦而磨损。

words.en: We could, at one time, repair ourselves — well enough, at least, to overcome all but the most instantly fatal illnesses and accidents.
words.zh: 我们可以暂时修复自己——至少足以克服除最直接致命的疾病和事故之外的所有疾病和事故。

words.en: Between twelve and eighty years we gradually lose this power; an illness which at 12 would knock us over, at 80 can knock us out, and into our grave.
words.zh: 十二到八十年间，我们逐渐失去了这种力量；这种疾病在 12 岁的时候会让我们崩溃，在 80 岁的时候会把我们击倒，然后进入坟墓。

words.en: If we could stay as vigorous as we are at twelve, it would take about 700 years for half of us to die, and another 700 for the survivors to be reduced by half again.
words.zh: 如果我们能像十二岁时那样精力充沛，大约需要700年，我们就会有一半的人死亡，而另外700年，幸存者又会减少一半。

words.en: Contamination of water supplies is usually due to poor sanitation close to water sources, sewage disposal into the sources themselves, leakage of sewage into distribution systems or contamination with industrial or farm waste.
words.zh: 供水污染通常是由于水源附近的卫生条件差、污水排入水源本身、污水泄漏到分配系统或工业或农业废物污染造成的。

words.en: Even if a piped water supply is safe at its source, it is not always safe by the time it reaches the tap.
words.zh: 即使管道供水在其源头是安全的，但到达水龙头时并不总是安全的。

words.en: Intermittent tap-water supplies should be regarded as particularly suspect.
words.zh: 间歇性的自来水供应尤其值得怀疑。

words.en: Travellers on short trips to areas with water supplies of uncertain quality should avoid drinking tap-water, or untreated water from any other source.
words.zh: 前往供水质量不稳定地区短途旅行的旅行者应避免饮用自来水或任何其他来源的未经处理的水。

words.en: It is best to keep to hot drinks, bottled or canned drinks of well-known brand names-international standard of water treatment are usually followed at bottling plants.
words.zh: 最好只喝热饮、知名品牌的瓶装或罐装饮料——装瓶厂通常遵循国际水处理标准。

words.en: Carbonated drinks are acidic, and slightly safer.
words.zh: 碳酸饮料是酸性的，稍微安全一些。

words.en: Make sure that all bottles are opened in your presence, and that their rims are clean and dry.
words.zh: 确保所有瓶子都在您面前打开，并且其边缘干净且干燥。

words.en: Boiling is always a good way of treating water.
words.zh: 煮沸始终是处理水的好方法。

words.en: Some hotels supply boiled water on request and this can be used for drinking, or for brushing teeth.
words.zh: 一些酒店可应要求提供开水，可用于饮用或刷牙。

words.en: Portable boiling elements that can boil small quantities of water are useful when the right voltage of electricity is available.
words.zh: 当电压合适时，可以煮沸少量水的便携式煮沸元件非常有用。

words.en: Refuse politely any cold drink from an unknown source.
words.zh: 礼貌地拒绝任何来源不明的冷饮。

words.en: Ice is only as safe as the water from which it is made, and should not be put in drinks unless it is known to be safe.
words.zh: 冰的安全性取决于其所用的水，除非已知冰是安全的，否则不应将其放入饮料中。

words.en: Drinks can be cooled by placing them on ice rather than adding ice to them.
words.zh: 饮料可以通过将它们放在冰上而不是加冰来冷却。

words.en: Alcohol may be a medical disinfectant, but should not be relied upon to sterilize water.
words.zh: 酒精可能是一种医用消毒剂，但不应依赖它来对水进行消毒。

words.en: Ethanol is more effective at a concentration of 50-70 percent; below 20 per cent, its bactericidal action is negligible.
words.zh: 乙醇浓度为 50-70% 时更有效；低于20%，其杀菌作用可以忽略不计。

words.en: Spirits labelled 95 proof contain only about 47 per cent alcohol.
words.zh: 标有 95 度的烈酒仅含有约 47% 的酒精度。

words.en: Beware of methylated alcohol, which is very poisonous and should never be added to drinking water.
words.zh: 谨防甲基化酒精，它毒性很大，切勿添加到饮用水中。

words.en: If no other safe water supply can be obtained, tap water that is too hot to touch can be left to cool and is generally safe to drink.
words.zh: 如果无法获得其他安全供水，可以将太热而无法触摸的自来水冷却，通常可以安全饮用。

words.en: Those planning a trip to remote areas, or intending to live in countries where drinking water is not readily available, should know about the various possible methods for making water safe.
words.zh: 那些计划前往偏远地区旅行或打算居住在无法获得饮用水的国家的人应该了解确保水安全的各种可能方法。

words.en: I have known very few writers, but those I have known and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
words.zh: 我认识的作家很少，但那些我认识的、我尊敬的作家都立刻承认，当他们第一次动笔写字时，他们几乎不知道自己要去哪里。

words.en: They have a character, perhaps two; they are in that condition of eager discomfort which passes for inspiration all admit radical changes of destination once the journey has begun; one, to my certain knowledge, spent nine months on a novel about Kashmir, then reset the whole thing in the Scottish Highlands.
words.zh: 他们有一个性格，也许有两个；他们处于一种急切的不适状态，这种感觉被视为灵感，一旦旅程开始，他们都会承认目的地发生根本性的改变。据我所知，其中一位花了九个月的时间写了一本关于克什米尔的小说，然后在苏格兰高地重置了整个事情。

words.en: I never heard of anyone making a 'skeleton', as we were taught at school.
words.zh: 我从来没有听说过有人制作“骷髅”，正如我们在学校所学到的那样。

words.en: In the breaking and remaking, in the timing interweaving, beginning afresh, the writer comes to discern things in his material which were not consciously in his mind when he began.
words.zh: 在打破和重塑中，在时间交织中，重新开始，作者开始在他的材料中辨别出一些在他开始时没有意识到的东西。

words.en: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.
words.zh: 这种有机的过程往往会带来非凡的自我发现时刻，具有难以形容的魅力。

words.en: A blurred image appears; he adds a brushstroke and another and it is gone but something was there, and he will not rest till he has captured it.
words.zh: 出现模糊的图像；他一笔又一笔地添加，它消失了，但有一些东西在那里，他不会休息，直到他捕捉到它。

words.en: Sometimes the yeast within a writer outlives a book he has written.
words.zh: 有时，作家内心的酵母比他写的书还要长久。

words.en: I have heard of writers who read nothing but their own books; like adolescents they stand before the mirror, and still cannot fathom the exact outline of the vision before them.
words.zh: 我听说过有些作家只读自己的书。他们像青少年一样站在镜子前，仍然无法理解眼前景象的确切轮廓。

words.en: For the same reason, writers talk interminably about their own books, winkling out hidden meanings, super-imposing new ones, begging response from those around them.
words.zh: 出于同样的原因，作家们没完没了地谈论自己的书，揭示隐藏的含义，强加新的含义，乞求周围人的回应。

words.en: Of course a writer doing this is misunderstood: he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair.
words.zh: 当然，这样做的作家会被误解：他还不如尝试解释犯罪或爱情。

words.en: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore.
words.zh: 顺便说一句，他也是一个不可原谅的讨厌鬼。

words.en: This temptation to cover the distance between himself and the reader, to study his image in the sight of those who do not know him, can be his undoing: he has begun to write to please.
words.zh: 这种拉近自己与读者之间距离、研究他在不认识他的人眼中的形象的诱惑，可能会导致他的毁灭：他已经开始为了取悦而写作。

words.en: A young English writer made the pertinent observation a year or two back that the talent goes into the first draft, and the art into the drafts that follow.
words.zh: 一位年轻的英国作家在一两年前做出了相关的观察：才华进入初稿，艺术进入随后的草稿。

words.en: For this reason also the writer, like any other artist, has no resting place, no crowd or movement in which he may take comfort, no judgment from outside which can replace the judgment from within.
words.zh: 因此，作家也像其他艺术家一样，没有休息的地方，没有人群或运动可以让他感到安慰，没有外部的判断可以取代内部的判断。

words.en: A writer makes order out of the anarchy of his heart; he submits himself to a more ruthless discipline than any critic dreamed of, and when he flirts with fame, he is taking time off from living with himself, from the search for what his world contains at its inmost point.
words.zh: 作家将内心的混乱整理得井井有条；他让自己受到比任何批评家所梦想的更无情的纪律，当他与名声调情时，他就从与自己相处的时间中抽出时间，从寻找他的世界最深处所包含的东西中抽出时间。

words.en: Waves are the children of the struggle between ocean and atmosphere, the ongoing signatures of infinity.
words.zh: 波浪是海洋和大气之间斗争的产物，是无限的持续特征。

words.en: Rays from the sun excite and energize the atmosphere of the earth, awakening it to flow, to movement, to rhythm, to life.
words.zh: 来自太阳的光线激发并激发了地球的大气层，唤醒它的流动、运动、节奏和生命。

words.en: The wind then speaks the message of the sun to the sea and the sea transmits it on through waves — an ancient, exquisite powerful message.
words.zh: 然后，风向大海传达太阳的信息，而大海则通过波浪将其传递下去——这是一种古老而精致、强大的信息。

words.en: These ocean waves are among the earth's most complicated natural phenomena.
words.zh: 这些海浪是地球上最复杂的自然现象之一。

words.en: The basic features include a crest (the highest point of the wave), a trough (the lowest point), a height (the vertical distance from the trough to the crest), a wave length (the horizontal distance between two wave crests), and a period (which is the time it takes awave crest to travel one wave length).
words.zh: 基本特征包括波峰（波的最高点）、波谷（最低点）、高度（从波谷到波峰的垂直距离）、波长（两个波峰之间的水平距离）和周期（波峰传播一个波长所需的时间）。

words.en: Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality waves move through the water leaving the water about where it was.
words.zh: 虽然海浪给人的印象是一堵水墙朝您的方向移动，但实际上，波浪穿过水，使水留在原来的位置。

words.en: If the water was moving with the wave, the ocean and everything on it would be racing in to the shore with obviously catastrophic results.
words.zh: 如果水随波浪移动，海洋和海洋上的一切都会冲向海岸，造成明显的灾难性后果。

words.en: An ocean wave passing through deep water causes a particle on the surface to move in a roughly circular orbit, drawing the particle first towards the advancing wave, then up into the wave, then forward with it and then — as the wave leaves the particles behind — back to its starting point again.
words.zh: 穿过深水的海浪导致表面上的粒子沿着大致圆形的轨道移动，首先将粒子拉向前进的波浪，然后向上进入波浪，然后与波浪一起前进，然后——当波浪将粒子抛在后面时——再次回到其起点。

words.en: From both maturity to death, a wave is subject to the same laws as any other 'living' thing.
words.zh: 从成熟到死亡，波浪与任何其他“生命”事物都遵循相同的法则。

words.en: For a time it assumes a miraculous individuality that, in the end, is reabsorbed into the great ocean of life.
words.zh: 有一段时间，它呈现出一种神奇的个性，最终被重新吸收到生命的浩瀚海洋中。

words.en: The undulating waves of the open sea are generated by three natural causes: wind, earth movements or tremors, and the gravitational pull of the moon and the sun.
words.zh: 公海起伏的波浪是由三种自然原因产生的：风、地球运动或震动，以及月球和太阳的引力。

words.en: Once waves have been generated, gravity is the force that drives them in a continual attempt to restore the ocean surface to a flat plain.
words.zh: 一旦波浪产生，重力就会驱动它们不断尝试将海洋表面恢复为平坦的平原。

words.en: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
words.zh: 训练大象主要使用两种技术，我们可以分别称之为“强硬”和“温和”。

words.en: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
words.zh: 前一种方法只是让大象工作并殴打它，直到它完成预期的任务。

words.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training, for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer.
words.zh: 撇开任何道德考虑不谈，这是一种愚蠢的训练方法，因为它会产生一种怨恨的动物，而这些动物在后期很可能会变成杀人犯。

words.en: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages, but produce a cheerful good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service.
words.zh: 温和的方法在早期阶段需要更多的耐心，但会产生一头性格开朗、脾气暴躁的大象，它将提供多年的忠诚服务。

words.en: The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job.
words.zh: 大象训练的首要任务是为大象指派一名驯象师，他将完全负责这项工作。

words.en: Elephants like to have one master just as dogs do, and are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
words.zh: 大象和狗一样喜欢有一个主人，并且有相当程度的个人感情。

words.en: There are even stories of half-trained elephant calves who have refused to feed and pined to death when by some unavoidable circumstance they have been deprived of their own trainer.
words.zh: 甚至有这样的故事：未经训练的小象由于某种不可避免的情况而被剥夺了自己的训练师，因此拒绝进食并被活活饿死。

words.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that the relationship between elephant and mahout is the key to successful training.
words.zh: 对于这种极端的案例，我们可能必须持保留态度，但它们确实强调了一个普遍原则：大象和驯象师之间的关系是成功训练的关键。

words.en: The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between 15 and 20 years, for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
words.zh: 捕捉大象进行训练最经济的年龄是 15 至 20 岁，因为此时大象几乎已经准备好承担繁重的工作，并且可以立即开始赚取收入。

words.en: But animals of this age do not easily become subservient to man, and a very firm hand must be employed in the early stages.
words.zh: 但这个时代的动物不容易屈服于人类，在早期阶段必须采取非常严厉的手段。

words.en: The captive elephant, still roped to a tree, plunges and screams every time a man approaches, and for several days will probably refuse all food through anger and fear.
words.zh: 被圈养的大象仍然被绳子绑在树上，每当有人靠近时，它就会跳下并尖叫，并且可能会在几天之内因愤怒和恐惧而拒绝所有食物。

words.en: Sometimes a tame elephant is tethered nearby to give the wild one confidence, and in most cases the captive gradually quietens down and begins to accept its food.
words.zh: 有时，一头驯服的大象会被拴在附近，以给野生大象信心，在大多数情况下，被俘虏的大象会逐渐安静下来并开始接受食物。

words.en: The next stage is to get the elephant to the training establishment, a ticklish business which is achieved with the aid of two tame elephants roped to the captive on either side.
words.zh: 下一阶段是将大象带到训练场所，这是一项棘手的工作，需要用绳子拴在两侧的驯服大象的帮助下才能完成。

words.en: When several elephants are being trained at one time, it is customary for the new arrival to be placed between the stalls of two captives whose training is already well advanced.
words.zh: 当同时训练多头大象时，通常会将新来的大象放置在两个已经接受过良好训练的俘虏的畜栏之间。

words.en: It is then left completely undisturbed with plenty of food and water so that it can absorb the atmosphere of its new home and see that nothing particularly alarming is happening to its companions.
words.zh: 然后让它完全不受干扰，并提供充足的食物和水，这样它就可以吸收新家的气氛，并看到它的同伴没有发生任何特别令人担忧的事情。

words.en: When it is eating normally, its own training begins.
words.zh: 当它正常进食时，它自己的训练就开始了。

words.en: The trainer stands in front of the elephant holding a long stick with a sharp metal point.
words.zh: 驯象师站在大象面前，手里拿着一根带有锋利金属尖的长棍。

words.en: Two assistants, mounted on tame elephants, control the captive from either side, while others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
words.zh: 两名助手骑在驯服的大象上，从两侧控制俘虏，而其他人则在单调而舒缓的圣歌的伴奏下用手摩擦他的皮肤。

words.en: This is supposed to induce pleasurable sensations in the elephant, and its effects are reinforced by the use of endearing epithets, such as 'ho! my son', or 'ho! my father', or 'my mother', according to the age and sex of the captive.
words.zh: 这应该会给大象带来愉悦的感觉，并且通过使用可爱的绰号（例如“嗬！”）来强化其效果。我的儿子”，或者“嗬！根据俘虏的年龄和性别，称其为“我的父亲”或“我的母亲”。

words.en: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments, however, and usually lashes fiercely with its trunk in all directions.
words.zh: 然而，大象不会立即受到这种甜言蜜语的影响，通常会用鼻子向各个方向猛烈地攻击。

words.en: These movements are controlled by the trainer with the metal-pointed stick, and the trunk eventually becomes so sore that the elephant curls it up and seldom afterwards uses it for offensive purposes.
words.zh: 这些动作是由训练员用金属尖头的棍子控制的，大象的鼻子最终会变得非常疼痛，以至于大象将其卷曲起来，之后很少将其用于攻击目的。

words.en: An earthquake comes like a thief in the night, without warning.
words.zh: 地震就像夜间的小偷一样毫无预兆地来袭。

words.en: It was necessary, therefore, to invent instruments that neither slumbered nor slept.
words.zh: 因此，有必要发明一种既不打盹也不睡觉的仪器。

words.en: Some devices were quite simple.
words.zh: 有些设备非常简单。

words.en: One, for instance, consisted of rods of various lengths and thicknesses which would stand up on end like ninepins.
words.zh: 例如，其中一种由不同长度和粗细的杆组成，这些杆可以像九瓶柱一样直立起来。

words.en: When a shock came, it shook the rigid table upon which these stood.
words.zh: 当震动袭来时，这些东西所在的坚硬桌子都震动了。

words.en: If it were gentle, only the more unstable rods fell.
words.zh: 如果动作轻柔，只有更不稳定的棒会掉落。

words.en: If it were severe, they all fell.
words.zh: 如果严重的话，他们都会倒下。

words.en: Thus the rods, by falling, and by the direction in which they fell, recorded for the slumbering scientist the strength of a shock that was too weak to waken him, and the direction from which it came.
words.zh: 因此，这些棒通过下落以及下落的方向，为沉睡的科学家记录了太弱而无法唤醒他的震动的强度，以及震动来自的方向。

words.en: But instruments far more delicate than that were needed if any really serious advance was to be made.
words.zh: 但如果要取得任何真正重大的进展，就需要比这更精密的仪器。

words.en: The ideal to be aimed at was to devise an instrument that could record with a pen on paper, the movements of the ground or of the table as the quake passed by.
words.zh: 我们的理想目标是设计一种仪器，可以用笔在纸上记录地震经过时地面或桌子的运动。

words.en: While I write my pen moves, but the paper keeps still.
words.zh: 当我写字时，笔在动，但纸却保持静止。

words.en: With practice, no doubt, I could in time learn to write by holding the pen still while the paper moved.
words.zh: 毫无疑问，通过练习，我很快就能学会在纸移动时握笔不动来写字。

words.en: That sounds a silly suggestion, but that was precisely the idea adopted in some of the early instruments (seismometers) for recording earthquake waves.
words.zh: 这听起来是一个愚蠢的建议，但这正是一些早期记录地震波的仪器（地震仪）所采用的想法。

words.en: But when table, penholder and paper are all moving, how is it possible to write legibly?
words.zh: 但桌子、笔杆、纸都在动，怎么可能写得清楚呢？

words.en: The key to a solution of that problem lay in an everyday observation.
words.zh: 解决这个问题的关键在于日常观察。

words.en: Why does a person standing in a bus or train tend to fall when a sudden start is made?
words.zh: 为什么站在公交车或火车上的人突然启动时容易摔倒？

words.en: It is because his feet move on, but his head stays still.
words.zh: 这是因为他的脚在前进，但他的头却保持静止。

words.en: A simple experiment will help us a little further.
words.zh: 一个简单的实验将帮助我们更进一步。

words.en: Tie a heavy weight at the end of a long piece of string.
words.zh: 在一根长绳子的末端系上一个重物。

words.en: With the hand held high in the air, hold the string so that the weight nearly touches the ground.
words.zh: 手高举在空中，握住绳子，使重物几乎接触地面。

words.en: Now move the hand to and fro and around but not up and down.
words.zh: 现在来回移动手，但不要上下移动。

words.en: It will be found that the weight moves but slightly or not at all.
words.zh: 会发现重量有轻微移动或根本没有移动。

words.en: Imagine a pen attached to the weight in such a way that its point rests upon a piece of paper on the floor.
words.zh: 想象一下，一支钢笔以这样一种方式连接到重物上，使其笔尖停留在地板上的一张纸上。

words.en: Imagine an earthquake shock shaking the floor, the paper, you and your hand.
words.zh: 想象一下地震震动了地板、纸张、你和你的手。

words.en: In the midst of all this movement, the weight and the pen would be still.
words.zh: 在所有这些运动过程中，重量和笔都是静止的。

words.en: But as the paper moved from side to side under the pen point, its movement would be recorded in ink upon its surface.
words.zh: 但是，当纸张在笔尖下从一侧移动到另一侧时，其移动会被墨水记录在其表面上。

words.en: It was upon this principle that the first instruments were made, but the paper was wrapped round a drum which rotated slowly.
words.zh: 正是根据这个原理，第一批乐器被制造出来，但纸被包裹在一个缓慢旋转的鼓上。

words.en: As long as all was still, the pen drew a straight line, but while the drum was being shaken, the line that the pen was drawing wriggled from side to side.
words.zh: 只要一切静止，笔就画出一条直线，但当鼓摇动时，笔所画的线就会左右蠕动。

words.en: The apparatus thus described, however, records only the horizontal component of the wave movement, which is, in fact, much more complicated.
words.zh: 然而，如此描述的装置仅记录波浪运动的水平分量，这实际上要复杂得多。

words.en: If we could actually see the path described by a particle, such as a sand grain in the rock, it would be more like that of a bluebottle buzzing round the room; it would be up and down, to and fro and from side to side.
words.zh: 如果我们真的能看到粒子（例如岩石中的沙粒）所描述的路径，那么它就更像是在房间里嗡嗡作响的蓝瓶苍蝇；它会上下、前后、左右。

words.en: Instruments have been devised and can be so placed that all three elements can be recorded in different graphs.
words.zh: 仪器的设计和放置可以使所有三个元素都可以记录在不同的图表中。

words.en: When the instrument is situated at more than 700 miles from the earthquake centre, the graphic record shows three waves arriving one after the other at short intervals.
words.zh: 当仪器位于距离地震中心超过 700 英里的地方时，图形记录显示三个波以很短的间隔相继到达。

words.en: The first records the arrival of longitudinal vibrations.
words.zh: 第一个记录纵向振动的到来。

words.en: The second marks the arrival of transverse vibrations which travel more slowly and arrive several minutes after the first.
words.zh: 第二个标志着横向振动的到来，横向振动的传播速度较慢，并且在第一个振动后几分钟到达。

words.en: These two have travelled through the earth.
words.zh: 这两个人已经穿越了地球。

words.en: It was from the study of these that so much was learnt about the interior of the earth.
words.zh: 正是通过对这些的研究，我们对地球内部有了很多了解。

words.en: The third, or main wave is the slowest and has travelled round the earth through the surface rocks.
words.zh: 第三波或主波是最慢的，并且通过地表岩石绕地球传播。

courses.title: Lesson 43 · Are There Strangers in Space?

words.en: We must conclude from the work of those who have studied the origin of life, that given a planet only approximately like our own, life is almost certain to start.
words.zh: 我们必须从那些研究生命起源的人的工作中得出结论，只要有一颗与我们的地球大致相似的行星，生命几乎肯定会开始。

words.en: Of all the planets in our solar system, we are now pretty certain the Earth is the only one on which life can survive.
words.zh: 在太阳系的所有行星中，我们现在非常确定地球是唯一一个有生命可以生存的行星。

words.en: Mars is too dry and poor in oxygen, Venus far too hot, and so is Mercury, and the outer planets have temperatures near absolute zero and hydrogen-dominated atmospheres.
words.zh: 火星太干燥且缺氧，金星太热，水星也是如此，外行星的温度接近零，大气层以氢为主。

words.en: But other suns, start as the astronomers call them, are bound to have planets like our own, and as is the number of stars in the universe is so vast, this possibility becomes virtual certainty.
words.zh: 但是其他太阳，正如天文学家所说的那样，必然有像我们自己的行星一样的行星，而且由于宇宙中恒星的数量如此巨大，这种可能性几乎成为必然。

words.en: There are one hundred thousand million starts in our own Milky Way alone, and then there are three thousand million other milky ways or galaxies, in the universe. so the number of stars that we know exist is now estimated at about 300 million million million.
words.zh: 仅在我们自己的银河系中就有十亿个恒星，然后在宇宙中还有三十亿个其他银河系或星系。因此，我们目前已知的恒星数量估计约为 3 亿颗。

words.en: Although perhaps only 1 percent of the life that has started somewhere will develop into highly complex and intelligent patterns, so vast is the number of planets, that intelligent life is bound to be a natural part of the universe.
words.zh: 尽管也许只有百分之一的生命会在某个地方开始发展成高度复杂和智能的模式，但行星的数量如此之多，智能生命必然是宇宙的自然组成部分。

words.en: If then we are so certain that other intelligent life exists in the universe, why have we had no visitors from outer space yet?
words.zh: 如果我们如此确信宇宙中存在其他智慧生命，为什么我们还没有来自外太空的访客呢？

words.en: First of all, they may have come to this planet of ours thousands or millions of years ago, and found our then prevailing primitive state completely uninteresting to their own advanced knowledge.
words.zh: 首先，他们可能在数千年或数百万年前来到我们这个星球，并发现我们当时盛行的原始状态对他们自己的先进知识完全不感兴趣。

words.en: Professor Ronald Bracewell, a leading American radio astronomer, argued in Nature that such a superior civilization, on a visit to our own solar system, may have left an automatic messenger behind to await the possible awakening of an advanced civilization.
words.zh: 美国著名射电天文学家罗纳德·布雷斯韦尔教授在《自然》杂志上指出，这样一个高级文明在访问我们自己的太阳系时，可能留下了一个自动信使，等待一个先进文明可能的觉醒。

words.en: Such a messenger, receiving our radio and television signals, might well re-transmit them back to its home-planet, although what impression any other civilization would thus get from us is best left unsaid.
words.zh: 这样一个接收我们的无线电和电视信号的信使很可能将它们重新传输回它的母星，尽管任何其他文明会从我们这里得到什么印象最好不要说。

words.en: But here we come up against the most difficult of all obstacles to contact with people on other planets — the astronomical distances which separate us.
words.zh: 但在这里，我们遇到了与其他星球上的人们接触的最困难的障碍——我们之间的天文距离。

words.en: As a reasonable guess, they might, on an average, be 100 light years away. (A light year is the distance which light travels at 186,000 miles per second in one year, namely 6 million million miles.) Radio waves also travel at the speed of light, and assuming such an automatic messenger picked up our first broadcasts of the 1920's, the message to its home planet is barely halfway there.
words.zh: 根据合理的猜测，它们平均距离可能有 100 光年。 （一光年是指光在一年内以每秒 186,000 英里的速度传播的距离，即 600 万英里。）无线电波也以光速传播，假设这样的自动信使收到了我们 1920 年代的第一次广播，那么发送到其母星的信息就只到了一半。

words.en: Similarly, our own present primitive chemical rockets, though good enough to orbit men, have no chance of transporting us to the nearest other star, four light years away, let alone distances of tens or hundreds of light years.
words.zh: 同样，我们现有的原始化学火箭虽然足以绕人类运行，但没有机会将我们运送到四光年之外最近的其他恒星，更不用说数十或数百光年的距离了。

words.en: Fortunately, there is a 'uniquely rational way' for us to communicate with other intelligent beings, as Walter Sullivan has put it in his excellent book, We Are not Alone.
words.zh: 幸运的是，正如沃尔特·沙利文在他的优秀著作《我们并不孤单》中所说，我们有一种“独特的理性方式”与其他智慧生物进行交流。

words.en: This depends on the precise radio frequency of the 21-cm wavelength, or 1420 megacycles per second.
words.zh: 这取决于 21 厘米波长的精确射频，即每秒 1420 兆周期。

words.en: It is the natural frequency of emission of the hydrogen atoms in space and was discovered by us in 1951; it must be known to any kind of radio astronomer in the universe.
words.zh: 它是氢原子在太空中发射的固有频率，由我们于1951年发现；宇宙中任何类型的射电天文学家都必须知道它。

words.en: Once the existence of this wave-length had been discovered, it was not long before its use as the uniquely recognizable broadcasting frequency for interstellar communication was suggested.
words.zh: 一旦发现这种波长的存在，不久之后就有人建议将其用作星际通信的唯一可识别的广播频率。

words.en: Without something of this kind, searching for intelligences on other planets would be like trying to meet a friend in London without a pre-arranged rendezvous and absurdly wandering the streets in the hope of a chance encounter.
words.zh: 如果没有这种东西，在其他星球上寻找智慧生物就像试图在没有预先安排的约会的情况下在伦敦与朋友见面一样，荒谬地在街道上徘徊，希望有机会相遇。

words.en: Custom has not commonly been regarded as a subject of any great moment.
words.zh: 习俗通常不被视为任何伟大时刻的主题。

words.en: The inner workings of our own brains we feel to be uniquely worthy of investigation, but custom, we have a way of thinking, is behaviour at is most commonplace.
words.zh: 我们觉得我们大脑的内部运作方式特别值得研究，但习惯，我们有一种思维方式，行为是最常见的。

words.en: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
words.zh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。

words.en: Traditional custom, taken the world over, is a mass of detailed behaviour more astonishing than what any one person can ever evolve in individual actions, no matter how aberrant.
words.zh: 全世界范围内的传统习俗是一整套详细的行为，比任何一个人在个人行为中所能演化出的东西（无论多么反常）更令人惊讶。

words.en: Yet that is a rather trivial aspect of the matter.
words.zh: 但这只是问题的一个相当微不足道的方面。

words.en: The fact of first-rate importance is the predominant role that custom plays in experience and in belief, and the very great varieties it may manifest.
words.zh: 最重要的事实是习俗在经验和信仰中发挥着主导作用，以及它可能表现出的巨大多样性。

words.en: No man ever looks at the world with pristine eyes.
words.zh: 没有人用纯净的眼睛看世界。

words.en: He sees it edited by a definite set of customs and institutions and ways of thinking.
words.zh: 他认为它是由一套明确的习俗、制度和思维方式编辑的。

words.en: Even in his philosophical probings he cannot go behind these stereotypes; his very concepts of the true and the false will still have reference to his particular traditional customs.
words.zh: 即使在他的哲学探索中，他也不能落后于这些刻板印象。他对真与假的概念仍然与他特定的传统习俗有关。

words.en: John Dewey has said in all seriousness that the part played by custom in shaping the behaviour of the individual, as against any way in which he can affect traditional custom, is as the proportion of the total vocabulary of his mother tongue against those words of his own baby talk that are taken up into the vernacular of his family.
words.zh: 约翰·杜威严肃地说，习惯在塑造个人行为方面所起的作用，与他影响传统习惯的任何方式相比，就如同他的母语总词汇量与他自己的儿语词汇中被吸收到他的家庭方言中的词汇的比例一样。

words.en: When one seriously studies the social orders that have had the opportunity to develop autonomously, the figure becomes no more than an exact and matter-of-fact observation.
words.zh: 当人们认真研究有机会自主发展的社会秩序时，这个数字只不过是一种精确而实事求是的观察。

words.en: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
words.zh: 个人的生活史首先是对其社区传统上传承的模式和标准的适应。

words.en: From the moment of his birth, the customs into which he is born shape his experience and behaviour.
words.zh: 从他出生的那一刻起，他出生的习俗就塑造了他的经历和行为。

words.en: By the time he can talk, he is the little creature of his culture, and by the time he is grown and able to take part in its activities, its habits are his habits, its beliefs his beliefs, its impossibilities his impossibilities.
words.zh: 当他会说话的时候，他就是他的文化中的小生物，当他长大并能够参与其活动时，它的习惯就是他的习惯，它的信仰就是他的信仰，它的不可能就是他的不可能。

words.en: Every child that is born into his group will share them with him, and no child born into one on the opposite side of the globe can ever achieve the thousandth part.
words.zh: 他所在群体中出生的每个孩子都会与他分享，而地球另一端出生的孩子永远无法达到千分之一。

words.en: There is no social problem it is more incumbent upon us to understand than this of the role of custom.
words.zh: 没有什么社会问题比习俗的作用更值得我们去理解了。

words.en: Until we are intelligent as to its laws and varieties, the main complicating facts of human life must remain unintelligible.
words.zh: 在我们了解其规律和多样性之前，人类生活的主要复杂事实必定仍然难以理解。

words.en: The study of custom can be profitable only after certain preliminary propositions have been accepted, and some of these propositions have been violently opposed.
words.zh: 对习惯的研究只有在某些初步命题被接受并且其中一些命题遭到强烈反对之后才能有利可图。

words.en: In the first place, any scientific study requires that there be no preferential weighting of one or another of the items in the series it selects for its consideration.
words.zh: 首先，任何科学研究都要求对其选择考虑的系列中的一个或另一个项目没有优先权重。

words.en: In all the less controversial fields, like the study of cacti or termites or the nature of nebulae, the necessary method of study is to group the relevant material and to take note of all possible variant forms and conditions.
words.zh: 在所有争议较小的领域，例如仙人掌或白蚁或星云性质的研究，必要的研究方法是将相关材料分组并记录所有可能的变异形式和条件。

words.en: In this way, we have learned all that we know of the laws of astronomy, or of the habits of the social insects, let us say.
words.zh: 通过这种方式，我们已经了解了所有我们所知道的天文学定律，或者说，社会性昆虫的习性。

words.en: It is only in the study of man himself that the major social sciences have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization.
words.zh: 只有在对人本身的研究中，主要的社会科学才取代了对一种局部变异即西方文明的研究。

words.en: Anthropology was by definition impossible, as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds.
words.zh: 只要我们自己和原始人、我们自己和野蛮人、我们自己和异教徒之间的这些区别仍然在人们的思想中占据主导地位，人类学从定义上来说就是不可能的。

words.en: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour's superstition.
words.zh: 首先有必要达到一种成熟的程度，使我们不再以自己的信仰来反对邻居的迷信。

words.en: It was necessary to recognize that these institutions which are based on the same premises, let us say the supernatural, must be considered together, our own among the rest.
words.zh: 有必要认识到，这些基于相同前提的机构，比如说超自然机构，必须放在一起考虑，我们自己的机构也在其他机构之中。

words.en: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
words.zh: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争一定是至关重要的。

words.en: But this phase of our development is now finished.
words.zh: 但我们的这一阶段的开发现已结束。

words.en: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
words.zh: 事实上，我们现在缺乏处理原始条件的实践和经验。

words.en: I am sure that, without modern weapons, I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
words.zh: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，我在与熊争论洞穴所有权时会表现得非常糟糕，在这方面我不认为我是孤立的。

words.en: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.
words.zh: 最后一个与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。

words.en: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
words.zh: 但即使是蚊子也因注意排水和化学喷雾而被抑制住了。

words.en: Competition between ourselves, person against person, community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
words.zh: 然而，我们之间、人与人、社区与社区之间的竞争仍然存在。而且还是一如既往的猛烈。

words.en: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
words.zh: 但人与人之间的竞争并不是生物学中想象的简单过程。

words.en: It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment, because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
words.zh: 它不是由物理环境决定的固定食物量的简单竞争，因为决定我们进化的环境本质上不再是物理的。

words.en: Our environment is chiefly conditoned by the things we believe.
words.zh: 我们的环境主要取决于我们所信仰的事物。

words.en: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes, both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
words.zh: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚州是地球上纬度非常相似的两个国家，都位于气候相似的大陆西海岸，并且可能拥有相当相似的自然资源。

words.en: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
words.zh: 然而，他们目前的发展却完全不同，这并不是因为不同的人，而是因为他们的居民心中存在着不同的想法。

words.en: This is the point I wish to emphasize.
words.zh: 这是我想强调的一点。

words.en: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
words.zh: 我们的环境中最重要的因素是我们自己的心态。

words.en: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture, the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
words.zh: 众所周知，在白人入侵原始文化的地方，最具破坏性的影响不是来自物质武器，而是来自思想。

words.en: Ideas are dangerous.
words.zh: 想法是危险的。

words.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
words.zh: 神圣办公室在过去导致异端分子被烧死的时候就清楚地知道这一点。

words.en: Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community, you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
words.zh: 事实上，言论自由的概念只存在于我们的现代社会中，因为当你身处一个社区时，你会受到社区习俗的制约，以至于很难想象出任何真正具有破坏性的东西。

words.en: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.
words.zh: 只有旁观者才能注入危险的想法。

words.en: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
words.zh: 我毫不怀疑，向现代世界注入会彻底摧毁我们的思想是可能的。

words.en: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.
words.zh: 我想给你举个例子，但幸运的是我不能这样做。

words.en: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.
words.zh: 或许只要提一下核弹就足够了。

words.en: Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society, one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying suffcient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
words.zh: 想象一下，在一个相当先进的技术社会中，一个仍然不拥有炸弹的社会，让其意识到这种可能性，并提供足够的细节来建造这种东西，会产生怎样的影响。

words.en: 20 or 30 pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925, would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
words.zh: 1925 年左右，向世界任何主要大国提供 20 或 30 页的信息，就足以改变世界历史的进程。

words.en: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
words.zh: 这是一个奇怪的想法，但我相信这是一个正确的想法，二十或三十页的想法和信息将能够颠覆当今世界，甚至摧毁它。

words.en: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain, but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
words.zh: 我经常尝试设想这些页面可能包含什么内容，但我当然不能这样做，因为我是当今世界的囚犯，就像你们所有人一样。

words.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or, to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside and then only if we are very original.
words.zh: 我们不能在我们的大脑所适应的特定模式之外思考，或者更准确地说，我们只能在非常有限的范围之外思考，而且只有当我们非常有创意时。

words.en: A gifted American psychologist has said, 'Worry is a spasm of the emotion; the mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.'
words.zh: 一位才华横溢的美国心理学家曾说过：“忧虑是一种情绪的痉挛；忧虑是一种情绪的痉挛；忧虑是情绪的痉挛。头脑抓住某些东西并且不会放开它。

words.en: It is useless to argue with the mind in this condition.
words.zh: 在这种情况下与头脑争论是没有用的。

words.en: The stronger the will, the more futile the task.
words.zh: 意志越坚强，任务就越徒劳。

words.en: One can only gently insinuate something else into its convulsive grasp.
words.zh: 一个人只能轻轻地将其他东西引入它的痉挛之中。

words.en: And if this something else is rightly chosen, if it is really attended by the illumination of another field of interest, gradually, and often quite swiftly, the old undue grip relaxes and the process of recuperation and repair begins.
words.zh: 如果正确地选择了其他的东西，如果它确实伴随着另一个感兴趣领域的启发，那么旧的不适当的束缚就会逐渐地、通常很快地放松下来，恢复和修复的过程就会开始。

words.en: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
words.zh: 因此，培养一种爱好和新的兴趣形式对于一个公众人物来说是最重要的政策。

words.en: But this is not a business that can be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will.
words.zh: 但这不是一天就能完成的事情，也不是仅仅靠意志就能迅速完成的事情。

words.en: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process.
words.zh: 另类心理兴趣的成长是一个漫长的过程。

words.en: The seeds must be carefully chosen; they must fall on good ground; they must be sedulously tended, if the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.
words.zh: 种子必须经过精心挑选；他们必须落在良好的基础上；如果要在需要时获得充满活力的果实，就必须精心照料它们。

words.en: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real.
words.zh: 要想真正快乐、真正安全，一个人至少应该有两到三种爱好，而且它们都必须是真实的。

words.en: It is no use starting late in life to say: 'I will take an interest in this or that.'
words.zh: 在晚年才说：“我会对这个或那个感兴趣”是没有用的。

words.en: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort.
words.zh: 这种尝试只会加剧脑力劳动的压力。

words.en: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet get hardly any benefit or relief.
words.zh: 一个人可能会获得与日常工作无关的大量知识，但几乎得不到任何好处或缓解。

words.en: It is no use doing what you like; you have got to like what you do.
words.zh: 做自己喜欢的事是没有用的；你必须喜欢你所做的事情。

words.en: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes: those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.
words.zh: 从广义上讲，人可以分为三类：劳累死的人、忧虑死的人、无聊死的人。

words.en: It is no use offering the manual labourer, tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.
words.zh: 对于体力劳动者来说，经过一周的辛劳和努力而疲惫不堪的体力劳动者在周六下午有机会踢足球或棒球是没有意义的。

words.en: It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or business man, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days, to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.
words.zh: 邀请已经工作或担心了六天严肃事情的政治家、专业人士或商人在周末工作或担心琐事是没有用的。

words.en: As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want, who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire — for them a new pleasure a new excitement is only an additional satiation.
words.zh: 至于那些不幸的人，他们可以掌控他们想要的一切，可以满足他们的任性，几乎可以得到所有欲望的对象——对他们来说，新的快乐、新的兴奋只是一种额外的满足。

words.en: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.
words.zh: 他们徒劳地疯狂地从一个地方跑到另一个地方，试图仅仅通过叮当声和动作来摆脱无聊的报复。

words.en: For them discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path.
words.zh: 对他们来说，某种形式的纪律是最有希望的道路。

words.en: It may also be said that rational, industrious, useful human beings are divided into two classes: first, those whose work is work and whose pleasure is pleasure; and secondly, those whose work and pleasure are one.
words.zh: 也可以说，理性的、勤奋的、有用的人分为两类：第一类，工作就是工作，快乐就是快乐；第二类，工作就是工作，快乐就是快乐；第二类，工作就是工作，快乐就是快乐。其次，那些工作与娱乐合二为一的人。

words.en: Of these the former are the majority.
words.zh: 其中，前者占大多数。

words.en: They have their compensations.
words.zh: 他们有他们的补偿。

words.en: The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward, not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest and most modest forms.
words.zh: 在办公室或工厂里长时间工作给他们带来的回报不仅是谋生手段，还有对快乐的强烈渴望，即使是最简单和最朴素的形式。

words.en: But Fortune's favoured children belong to the second class.
words.zh: 但命运眷顾的孩子却属于第二等。

words.en: Their life is a natural harmony.
words.zh: 他们的生活是自然和谐的。

words.en: For them the working hours are never long enough.
words.zh: 对他们来说，工作时间永远不够长。

words.en: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays, when they come, are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation.
words.zh: 每天都是假期，而普通的假期一旦到来，就会被视为强行打断令人着迷的职业而感到不情愿。

words.en: Yet to both classes, the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere of a diversion of effort, is essential.
words.zh: 然而，对于这两个阶级来说，需要另一种观点、改变气氛或转移精力，这是至关重要的。

words.en: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.
words.zh: 事实上，那些以工作为乐的人很可能最需要时不时地把工作从自己的脑海中驱逐出去的人。

words.en: Economy is one powerful motive for camping, since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
words.zh: 经济是露营的一个强大动机，因为在设备或租赁设备的初始支出之后，总费用可能远远低于酒店的费用。

words.en: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
words.zh: 但是，与流行的假设相反，它远不是唯一的，甚至不是最伟大的。

words.en: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his 20 pounds' worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.
words.zh: 一个人如果不小心进入欧洲无数永久性地点之一的 20 磅重的空间，可能会发现自己撞上了一辆宾利车。

words.en: More likely, Ford Escort will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes, but rarely with bicycles made for two.
words.zh: 更有可能的是，福特 Escort 将与雷诺或梅赛德斯进行枢纽对枢纽，但很少会提供两人自行车。

words.en: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic, a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
words.zh: 现代露营的设备每年都变得更加先进，这对于愤世嫉俗的人来说是一个有趣的悖论，对于那些发誓要远离这一切的满怀希望的旅行者来说，这是一个更光明的希望。

words.en: It also provides — and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon — an escape of another kind.
words.zh: 它还提供了另一种逃避方式——一些学生社会学家可能愿意将他的论文建立在这种现象的基础上。

words.en: The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista, not because he cannot afford, or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them.
words.zh: 现代旅行者常常不喜欢辉煌和贝拉维斯塔，不是因为他负担不起或回避它们的物质享受，而是因为他害怕它们。

words.en: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.
words.zh: 他可能很富有，但他决不知道该给门童或女服务员多少小费。

words.en: Master in his own house he has little idea of when to say boo to a manager hotel.
words.zh: 当他在自己家里当主人时，他不知道什么时候该对酒店经理说“嘘”。

words.en: From all such fears camping releases him.
words.zh: 露营让他摆脱了所有这些恐惧。

words.en: Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists; but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with.
words.zh: 诚然，基于装备和技术的露营本身已经存在一种势利。但这是一种如果他遇到了，他就能轻易理解和处理的事情。

words.en: There is no superior 'they' in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days.
words.zh: 管理层和酒店等级制度中没有高级的“他们”让他的假期变得黯淡。

words.en: To such motives, yet another must be added.
words.zh: 除了这些动机之外，还必须加上另一个动机。

words.en: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.
words.zh: 当代汽车崇拜现象的一个重要原因是拥有权所带来的独立和自由感。

words.en: To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement.
words.zh: 露营给这种乐趣带来了精致的享受。

words.en: From one's own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again, everything is to hand.
words.zh: 从自己的前门到家乡或外国的山丘或沙滩，然后再返回，一切都在手边。

words.en: Not only are the means of arriving at the holiday paradise entirely within one's own command and keeping, but the means of escape from holiday hell (if the beach proves too crowded, the local weather too inclement) are there, outside — or, as likely, part of — the tent.
words.zh: 不仅到达度假天堂的方法完全由个人掌控和掌握，而且逃离假日地狱的方法（如果海滩太拥挤，当地天气太恶劣）就在那里，在帐篷外面——或者很可能是帐篷的一部分。

words.en: Idealists have objected to the practice of camping, as to the package tour, that the traveller abroad thereby denies himself the opportunity of getting to know the people of the country visited.
words.zh: 理想主义者反对露营的做法，就像旅行团一样，因为出国旅游的人因此而失去了了解所到国家人民的机会。

words.en: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
words.zh: 有人认为，孤立性和自我封闭是相辅相成的。

words.en: The opinion does not survive experience of a popular Continental camping place.
words.zh: 这种观点并不适用于流行的大陆露营地的体验。

words.en: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.
words.zh: 度假酒店往往专门为某一国籍的游客提供服务，有时甚至专门针对某一国籍的游客。

words.en: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
words.zh: 相比之下，露营地则高度国际化。

words.en: Granted, a preponderance of Germans is a characteristic that seems common to most Mediterranean sites; but as yet there is no overwhelmingly specialized patronage.
words.zh: 诚然，德国人占多数是大多数地中海地区的共同特征。但迄今为止还没有压倒性的专门赞助。

words.en: Notices forbidding the open-air drying of clothes, or the use of water points for car washing, or those inviting 'our camping friends' to a dance or a boat trip are printed not only in French or Italian or Spanish, but also in English, German and Dutch.
words.zh: 禁止露天晾晒衣服、禁止使用水点洗车、禁止邀请“我们的露营朋友”跳舞或乘船游览的通知不仅用法语、意大利语或西班牙语印制，还用英语、德语和荷兰语印制。

words.en: At meal times the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic.
words.zh: 吃饭的时候，酸菜的气味和大蒜的气味相互竞争。

words.en: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman's bacon and eggs.
words.zh: 法国人的早餐咖啡与英国人的培根和鸡蛋竞争。

words.en: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say.
words.zh: 很难说有组织的露营活动的显着增长是否意味着更独立的露营活动的最终消亡。

words.en: Municipalities naturally want to secure the campers' site fees and other custom.
words.zh: 市政当局自然希望确保露营者的场地费和其他习俗。

words.en: Police are wary of itinerants who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls.
words.zh: 警方对无法追踪到公认的营地边界或四堵墙的流动人员保持警惕。

words.en: But most probably it will all depend upon campers themselves: how many heath fires they cause; how much litter they leave; in short, whether or not they wholly alienate landowners and those who live in the countryside.
words.zh: 但很可能这一切都取决于露营者自己：他们引起了多少荒野火灾；他们留下了多少垃圾；简而言之，他们是否完全疏远了土地所有者和农村居民。

words.en: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout.
words.zh: 只有良好的童子军才能维护永恒童子军心中所珍视的自由。

words.en: There is no shortage of tipsters around offering 'get-rich-quick' opportunities.
words.zh: 围绕提供“快速致富”机会的消息人士并不缺乏。

words.en: But if you are a serious private investor, leave the Las Vegas mentality to those with money to fritter.
words.zh: 但如果你是一位严肃的私人投资者，那就把拉斯维加斯的心态留给那些有钱可以挥霍的人吧。

words.en: The serious investor needs a proper 'portfolio' — a well-planned selection of investments, with a definite structure and a clear aim.
words.zh: 认真的投资者需要一个合适的“投资组合”——精心策划的投资选择，具有明确的结构和明确的目标。

words.en: But exactly how does a newcomer to the stock market go about achieving that?
words.zh: 但股市新手究竟如何实现这一目标呢？

words.en: Well, if you go to five reputable stock brokers and ask them what you should do with your money, you're likely to get five different answers, — even if you give all the relevant information about your age, family, finances and what you want from your investments.
words.zh: 好吧，如果你去找五位信誉良好的股票经纪人，问他们你应该用你的钱做什么，你很可能会得到五种不同的答案——即使你提供了有关你的年龄、家庭、财务状况以及你想从投资中得到什么的所有相关信息。

words.en: Moral?
words.zh: 道德？

words.en: There is no one 'right' way to structure a portfolio.
words.zh: 没有一种“正确”的方法来构建投资组合。

words.en: However, there are undoubtedly some wrong ways, and you can be sure that none of our five advisers would have suggested sinking all (or perhaps any) of your money into Periwigs.
words.zh: 然而，毫无疑问，存在一些错误的方法，并且您可以肯定，我们的五位顾问中没有一个会建议将您的所有（或可能任何）资金投入假发。

words.en: So what should you do?
words.zh: 那么你应该做什么呢？

words.en: We'll assume that you have sorted out the basics — like mortgages, pensions, insurance and access to sufficient cash reserves.
words.zh: 我们假设您已经解决了基本问题，例如抵押贷款、养老金、保险和获得足够的现金储备。

words.en: You should then establish your own individual aims.
words.zh: 然后你应该建立自己的个人目标。

words.en: These are partly a matter of personal circumstances, partly a matter of psychology.
words.zh: 这些部分是个人情况的问题，部分是心理问题。

words.en: For instance, if you are older you have less time to recover from any major losses, and you may well wish to boost your pension income.
words.zh: 例如，如果您年龄较大，那么从重大损失中恢复过来的时间就会减少，您可能希望增加养老金收入。

words.en: So preserving your capital and generating extra income are your main priorities.
words.zh: 因此，保存您的资本并创造额外收入是您的首要任务。

words.en: In this case, you'd probably construct a portfolio with some shares (but not high risk ones), along with gilts, cash deposits, and perhaps convertibles or the income shares of split capital investment trusts.
words.zh: 在这种情况下，您可能会构建一个包含一些股票（但不是高风险股票）的投资组合，以及国债、现金存款，或许还有可转换债券或分割资本投资信托的收入份额。

words.en: If you are younger, and in a solid financial position, you may decide to take an aggressive approach — but only if you're blessed with a sanguine disposition and won't suffer sleepless nights over share prices.
words.zh: 如果你比较年轻，财务状况稳健，你可能会决定采取激进的做法——但前提是你有乐观的性格，不会因为股价而彻夜难眠。

words.en: If you recognize yourself in this description, you might include a couple of heady growth stocks in your portfolio, alongside your more pedestrian investments.
words.zh: 如果您在这个描述中认识到自己，那么您可能会在您的投资组合中加入几只令人兴奋的成长型股票，以及您的平庸投资。

words.en: Once you have decided on your investment aims you can then decide where to put your money.
words.zh: 一旦您决定了投资目标，您就可以决定将资金投入何处。

words.en: The golden rule here is spread your risk — if you put all of your money into Periwigs International, you're setting yourself up as a hostage to fortune.
words.zh: 这里的黄金法则是分散风险——如果把所有的钱都投进佩里威格国际公司，你就是在拿自己的命运下注。
